# Bhavesh Jain

> Data scientist in Heilbronn, Germany. Machine learning systems for forecasting,
> LLM evaluation, and strategic foresight — at Fraunhofer ISI and the Joint
> Innovation Hub, plus independent work on multi-agent foresight tooling.

This is a personal portfolio site built with static HTML. Cloudflare may apply
security checks. Content is free to cite with attribution to Bhavesh Jain
(https://bhaveshjain.com/).

- [German version](https://bhaveshjain.com/de/): same content, in German
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://bhaveshjain.com/assets/resume.pdf)

## Writing

- [Blog](https://blog.bhaveshjain.com/): notes on AI/ML, product development, and strategic foresight
- [Product development](https://blog.bhaveshjain.com/#product): discovery, MVPs, delivery, metrics, experimentation, prioritization, and build-versus-buy decisions
- [RSS feed](https://blog.bhaveshjain.com/feed.xml)
- [How to actually evaluate an LLM application](https://blog.bhaveshjain.com/how-to-evaluate-llm-apps.html): the flagship piece on building evaluation sets that catch regressions

## Work

- Vorschau: multi-agent foresight platform for small and mid-sized companies
- JIH Trend Radar: bibliometric mining and weak-signal detection for emerging technology
- Air cargo demand forecasting: M.Sc. thesis, 12% better than the ARIMA baseline
